      public VisionCameraIOSim(VisionCameraIO.VisionCfg cfg, Supplier<Pose3d> robotPose)
      Constructs a VisionCameraIOSim, setting up a PhotonVision simulation camera with the provided intrinsics and attaching it to the shared VisionSystemSim.
      Parameters:
      cfg - camera configuration (name, resolution, intrinsics, robot-to-camera transform)
